title: Eligible population
one_line_definition: This chart tracks the monthly count of members eligible for risk adjustment in the current year compared to the same months in the previous year, enabling year-over-year trend analysis.
result_meaning: Compare the current-year line against the previous-year line each month to identify whether the eligible population is growing, shrinking, or holding steady relative to the prior period. A consistently higher current-year line indicates membership growth, while a lower line signals attrition that may reduce the total risk adjustment opportunity. Sudden divergences mid-year — such as a sharp drop or spike in the current-year line — can indicate plan enrollment changes, eligibility policy updates, or data loading issues that warrant investigation. Use the YoY % change to quickly quantify the magnitude of these shifts and prioritize outreach or operational responses accordingly.
